Type B: Typical unit with bedroom side window exposed to re-entrant fire

3.4.6. These room units only have kitchen windows, bathroom windows and side windows of bedrooms facing the extended re-entrant fire. After analysing the photos of post-fire room units, it is clearly seen that glass breakage at kitchens and bathrooms did not introduce fire spreading into room units, except in some rare cases. This is because limited combustible items existed near the windows of kitchens and bathrooms. The side windows of main bedroom are relatively far from the re-entrant area, which caused limited fire impact on the glass windows.
